accepted_criteria: The v2 model explicitly changes both geometry funding and monotone chemical-stroke settlement while preserving prior contract/specification history. It does not claim the prior naive adapter became realizable.

The finite source is an explicitly assumed ideal coarse-grained A-to-W battery. Its work enters through the owned conversion coordinate xi=a and the reciprocal Ec, rather than an observer energy bucket or independently initialized tank.
Cold entry has L=L0,a=0,b=P and zero Ec/Us. Prepared inactive polarity and scaffold are declared initial material conditions, not simulated synthesis or unexplained elastic preload.

On the fixed-material domain L0>=1e-3 and 0<L<=4L0, the receiver derivative exactly matches native stretch: compression stiffness ks/L0 and tension stiffness phi*ks/L0, with no active clamp. The piecewise energy is C1 and convex.

At fixed geometry the monotone conversion path has its unique possible minimum at P*epsilon/lambda. Funding all uphill variation Vplus and dissipating downhill variation Vminus prevents cross-minimum within-stroke recycling even when endpoint energies are equal.
Complete pre-stroke finite-A reservation, distinct overhead, A/W and active/inactive material closure give DeltaEA+DeltaEc+Qchem=0 without A regeneration or counting W again as heat.

Fixed-pool mechanics uses both Ec and Us in one discrete-gradient force balance. It satisfies DeltaEc+DeltaUs+Qdrag=0 and never charges geometry A top-up. Coupling release can enter the receiver rather than all being assigned to heat.

The true receiver secant handles crossing L0. Convexity makes that secant nondecreasing and the scalar residual strictly increasing; a certified in-domain bracket establishes existence of at most one admissible scalar root.
Finite capacity bounds follow from the sealed domain, and the combined initial battery/store/heat invariant excludes a hidden unbounded energy source.

The reference cycle wrapper publishes only after reaction and mechanics succeed; a deliberate late mechanical failure retains the original state and cumulative sinks. Unsupported material/topology/other-force ports are explicitly rejected rather than claimed integrated.

The anchor inventory separates native constitutive facts, explicit new design assumptions, external observed measurement methods, unit conventions and missing independent project parameter data. Production values remain null.
The scoped workflow and checker bind exact-head source/history, prior contracts and all five independently reviewed artifacts without launching a native or biological workload.

limitations: Acceptance is for a closed bounded proposed mathematical architecture and source-based receiver derivation, not a measured physical mechanism or production implementation.

The ideal battery, coupling energy and signed kinetic bias are explicit new constitutive assumptions. First-law closure does not establish local detailed balance, gross turnover, ATP identity or empirical calibration.

Reference reaction extents are prescribed finite strokes. The checker does not execute the native biased-J trajectory or identify theta; its illustrative numbers are not selected production parameters.
The positive-geometry Ec-from-Us fixture proves a local signed work identity with a declared owned preload. It is not proof that this preloaded state was reached from the sole cold entry.

The pinned scalar prototype is distinct from a free endpoint pair, a rotating edge or a whole mesh. It excludes pressure, bending, native active forces, contact projection, external work, diffusion, synthesis and topology/material changes.
The mathematical scalar uniqueness argument does not certify floating solver accuracy, general mesh roots, contact compatibility, native Euler parity or full A-dependent causal staging.
Reference immutable-state rollback and exact rational arithmetic do not certify production transactions, persistent checkpoints, runtime overflow handling or lifecycle partitioning.

The native ks/gamma and scaffold law anchor their own model components. Independent K/lambda/theta/epsilon_A data and species/unit mappings remain missing; cited experiments supply methods rather than project numerical values.
No corrected R13 damping, morphogenesis, reproduction, selection, reversal or lifeform completion follows from this review. Implementation and calibration require separate authorization.
Parent-owned checker execution, hosted exact-head CI, archive reconstruction, preservation and Notion synchronization remain separate evidence and were not performed by this reviewer.
